rows: Your ground work is good. I will make you earn the entry.
Your strikes are strong. A good match requires control after contact.
When your feet leave the canvas, you need a controlled landing. I will meet you there.
Do not make the people wait while you dictate a pace. I expect a contest.
They paid to see us wrestle. Deliver the full match.
Watch the ring. I will demonstrate what I mean.
The standard of this match matters more than its position on the card. I intend to set the highest one.
Look closely. That is the standard you must meet.
Then defend the entry correctly. I will not offer it to you.
Stay disciplined after the first strike. That will be the test.
You must time the catch properly. Nothing less will work.
I am controlling the tempo. You are welcome to try to change it.
Agreed. We both have a duty to deliver.
Prove your standard in the ring before you claim the billing.
Your {strength} require a disciplined answer. I am prepared for that.
I acknowledge your {strength}. I will not let them dictate my decisions.
I have no personal grievance. My objective is to win.
No raised voices. I will see you in the ring.
Anger is not a substitute for discipline.
A single fall, precisely. No outside involvement. Those are the terms.
Meet me on the canvas. Demonstrate your technique.
Keep your feet on the mat and wrestle me.
Stay inside the ropes until the contest is finished.
That was not the question. Answer it precisely.
I expect a demanding contest. I will win it.
My objective is clear. I aim to take it.
A clean fall in the centre. No shortcut for me.
I have nothing further to say.
My preparation is complete. You will see it at the bell.
The allegation does not meet the standard of proof I demand. I withdraw it.
You are correct to demand particulars. I cannot provide sufficient evidence.
Correction accepted. The allegation is removed; the sporting contest remains.
Good. That point is settled. Maintain the same discipline in the ring.
The contest will demonstrate whether our technique remains controlled under resistance. Judge that.
Observe the execution and the legal result. Neither requires an unsupported accusation.
